stories.title: U2 to play M&T Bank Stadium in August
stories.summary: Rock band U2 will play a show at Baltimore's M&T Bank Stadium in August, event promoter Live Nation announced on Tuesday.

stories.title: Baltimore Ravens donate $50,000 to Edgar Allan Poe house and museum, Poe bust on display at M&T Bank Stadium
stories.summary: The Baltimore Ravens have partnered with Poe Baltimore, donating $50,000 to the nonprofit organization to help offset costs affecting the Edgar Allan Poe House & Museum, a release from the team said​.

stories.title: Orioles agree with Freddy Peralta on $125 million, 5-year deal, AP source says
stories.summary: The Baltimore Orioles and free agent right-hander Freddy Peralta have agreed to a $125 million, five-year contract, a source told The Associated Press on Tuesday.

stories.title: Body discovered in roadway in Shadyside, Maryland, Anne Arundel County police investigate
stories.summary: Police in Anne Arundel County are investigating a body that was discovered early Tuesday in the community of Shadyside, Maryland.

stories.title: Maryland jockey arrested by ICE in Ocean City, horsemen's group says
stories.summary: A Maryland jockey has been detained by ICE in Ocean City, according to a Baltimore-based thoroughbred horsemen's group.

stories.title: Frying a turkey this Thanksgiving? Baltimore Fire Department warns proceed with caution.
stories.summary: As Marylanders prepare for Thanksgiving feasts, the Baltimore City Fire Department is teaming up with the American Red Cross to promote safety.

stories.title: After several finalists withdraw, Annapolis turns to recruitment firm to find city's next police chief
stories.summary: Annapolis leaders have decided to hire a recruitment firm to find the city's next police chief after several finalists for the job withdrew from consideration.

stories.title: Talking Turkey: How to safely consume Thanksgiving leftovers and prevent foodborne illnesses
stories.summary: Dr. Nicole Cimino-Fiallos, urgent care physician at Kaiser Permanente, shares important guidelines on how long leftovers are safe to consume after Thanksgiving, and which symptoms of food poisoning mean it’s time to call a doctor.

stories.title: Paws N' Claws: Meet Olive, a 3-year-old American Pit looking for a home for the holidays
stories.summary: Alexa Jones, Baltimore Humane Society, and Olive join us in studio to talk about the wonderful things going on at the shelter and their upcoming Photos with Santa event happening at the Owings Mills Petco.

stories.title: The first annual Krampuslauf Yule Market debuts Saturday November 28 at Roosevelt Park
stories.summary: The Baltimore Krampus and Melissa Salzman from Lovelyarns, talk about the holiday market and what attendees can expect to see.

stories.title: Chyno's Peace of the Pie, a collab with The Charmery, is back for a good cause
stories.summary: Chyno the Blue Bearded Foodie, Charmery Founder David Alima, and Marina Thompson from the Maryland AFSP all join us to tell us how the collaboration came about, and the important cause it benefits.

stories.title: Around Town: Kennedy Krieger's Festival of Trees returns Thanksgiving weekend to the Maryland State Fairgrounds
stories.summary: Stephanie Douglas is live from the Festival of Trees getting a first look at all the decorated trees and exciting vendors.
